name: Garren's Haunt
summary: Rot Hide gnolls prowl the ruined fields of Garren's Haunt in northern Tirisfal. The Garren family farmed here until the Scourge slaughtered them and left their home to decay.

sections.title: A Blighted Homestead
sections.body: Under the Kingdom of Lordaeron, Garren's Haunt fed a human family. Before the Third War, its fields gave bountiful harvests. Then the Plague of Undeath swept across the countryside, and the Scourge came to the farm. Garren and his kin were slaughtered. Now gray, withered fields surround a farmhouse and barn, both decaying beneath Tirisfal's gloom.

sections.title: The Rot Hide Squatters
sections.body: Rot Hide gnolls have claimed the farm, led by the vicious Maggot Eye. Tainted by undeath, they defend their scavenged ground fiercely. They pick clean what remains and savage travelers or Forsaken patrols passing through northern Tirisfal.

faq.answer: Garren was a human farmer who lived here with his family before the Third War. They worked the fields until the Scourge overran Lordaeron and butchered the household as the plague spread.

faq.q: What creatures occupy the farm now?
faq.answer: Rot Hide gnolls led by Maggot Eye occupy the farm. They prowl its fields and buildings, attacking those who come too close.

faq.q: Why is it called Garren's Haunt?
faq.answer: The farm bears the name of its murdered owner, Garren. “Haunt” describes the grim, abandoned land left to rot after his family was slain beneath Tirisfal's pall.

faq.q: Why haven't the Forsaken reclaimed it?
faq.answer: The Forsaken are stretched thin fortifying the Undercity and battling the Scarlet Crusade and active Scourge remnants. Passing mercenaries and adventurers are largely left to deal with scavengers like the Rot Hide gnolls at outlying farms.

angles.text: The ruined farm recalls the slaughter that preceded the Forsaken. Clearing out the Rot Hide gnolls helps secure northern Tirisfal for the Dark Lady.
